_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Technology extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Technology the CONDITION-CODES never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger, AND (unlike Finance) the DIAGNOSIS IDS never equal a trigger either, because Technology activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (like Energy), not diagnosis ids. This table bridges condition-code / diagnosis-id -> the free-text triggers of the circuit nodes each one lights up.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(technology-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L133-155)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L165-171)--> diagnosis id --(technology.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data: issue id === activation-circuit membership). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop, which in Technology is COARSE (see heterogeneityVsFinance).
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, L165-171). In Technology the ONLY family the inline classifier emits that ANY contract consumes is news_event, and EVERY one of the 6 contracts lists news_event in requiredFamilies — so a single news_event-emitting condition folds to ALL SIX diagnoses. This is faithful to the code gate but is a coarse family-level link, NOT a semantic indicator match; it is flagged, not hidden.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from technology.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinance: STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT, and further from Finance than Finance was from Energy. (1) Technology activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (e.g. 'Intrusion detection alert'), NOT diagnosis ids — so, unlike Finance, the diagnosis id NEVER self-matches a trigger and this whole alias table is STRICTLY required for the diagnoses hop, not just the condition hop. (2) The inline condition classifier (L133-155) operates on a GENERIC / education-derived condition vocabulary (budget_shortfall, institutional_decline, workforce_gap, digital_divide, ...) that does NOT correspond to the Technology EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS' own indicator tokens (cyber_breach, ransomware, ai_misalignment, ...). The two vocabularies are bridged by exactly ONE family: news_event. (3) Consequently the REAL Technology indicator tokens (24 of them: cyber_breach, network_intrusion, ransomware, ... market_concentration) are named in contracts but are NEVER classified by the engine — they are contract-only-unclassified (see contractOnlyTokensNotClassified). Finance had tokens:[] here; Technology has 24. THIS IS THE KEY HETEROGENEITY. (4) Six evidence families the classifier emits (policy_event, institutional_event, workforce_event, indicator_event, structural_event, macro_event) are consumed by NO contract = dead-ends (Finance had one dead-end, macro_event; Technology has six). (5) Orphan count: Energy 1, Finance 3, Technology 5.

Each linked diagnosis expands to its issues[]._authored circuit nodeIds (technology.json) and those activations' FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers (union shown). COARSE LINK: 'digital_divide' does not semantically pick out any single Technology issue; it merely emits the one bridging family. institutional_event is a dead-end (no contract consumes it).

CYBER_ATTACK.basis: diagnosis id === Technology issue id; when active, the (energy-pattern) adapter marks its issues['CYBER_ATTACK']._authored circuit nodes active (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L79-101). This alias lists exactly those brainNodeIds [CeA, CC, DMN, HIPP, FORN] and their activations' FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers. Direct data link, no inference. Because Technology triggers are free-text (not diagnosis ids as in Finance), the diagnosis id CYBER_ATTACK matches NONE of these strings on its own — the alias is what protects every node in the circuit from extinction.

contractOnlyTokensNotClassified.reason: THE KEY HETEROGENEITY vs Finance (which had tokens:[], N/A). These 24 tokens are the REAL Technology indicator vocabulary — the primaryIndicators of all 6 EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS (technology-pulse-engine.js L34-89). NONE of them is handled by the inline classify() switch (L133-155), which instead classifies a disjoint, generic/education-derived condition vocabulary. So no live condition ever emits the family these tokens imply; the contracts can only be satisfied via the incidental news_event bridge (see conditionCodes) or by direct diagnosis activation. These tokens have no condition->family->diagnosis path and therefore no grounded alias here. Contrast: the two secondaryConfirmation tokens that ARE classified — 'macro_shock' (->macro_event) and 'structural_stress' (->structural_event) — still reach no diagnosis because their families are dead-ends (see unmapped.conditionCodes).
